name: QUIPS
license_note: Domain names and prompts are paraphrases. The official wording is linked, not bundled.
notes: Six domain-level judgements for prognostic factor studies. The official guidance derives no aggregate score, so no overall judgement is derived. Judgements are entered by reviewers with quotes; signalling answers are supporting detail only.

domains.name: Study participation
domains.short_prompt: Whether the source cohort and enrolled participants are representative of the population in which the prognosis applies.

signalling.prompt: Is the source of the cohort clearly described and appropriate?
Are included participants representative of people with the disease in the review question?

domains.name: Study attrition
domains.short_prompt: Whether follow-up is complete enough, with similar reasons for withdrawal across exposure groups.

signalling.prompt: Are completers and non-completers comparable at baseline?
Is follow-up sufficiently long and complete?
Are withdrawal or loss-to-follow-up reasons similar across prognostic groups?

domains.name: Prognostic factor measurement
domains.short_prompt: Whether the prognostic factor is measured with a valid and reliable, pre-specified assessment.

signalling.prompt: Is the prognostic factor defined with inclusion and exclusion criteria?
Was measurement valid and reliable, and assessed blind to outcome where relevant?

domains.name: Outcome measurement
domains.short_prompt: Whether the outcome is clearly defined, well described, and assessed with suitable methods without knowledge of the prognostic factor.

signalling.prompt: Is the outcome clearly defined and appropriate for the research question?
Was outcome assessment blind to prognostic factor status?

domains.name: Study confounding
domains.short_prompt: Whether the effect of important confounders is minimised or controlled in design or analysis.

signalling.prompt: Are confounding factors identified from previous work or sensible reasoning?
Are measured confounders controlled in the analysis?

domains.name: Statistical analysis and reporting
domains.short_prompt: Whether the number of events is adequate, analyses appropriate, and results reported without selective or post-hoc choices driving the finding.

signalling.prompt: Is the number of events and participants sufficient for the analysis performed?
Is the statistical analysis appropriate for the prognostic question?
Was the analysis pre-specified, or is a post-hoc or selective analysis a concern?
